programmes.d: The Bradys try to escape a jail cell while visiting a ghost town.
Cindy and Bobby get lost while roaming around the Grand Canyon.
Greg gets stuck with a clunker when he buys his friend’s car.
Greg and Marcia use their dates to get back at each other; the younger Brady siblings prepare for the school carnival by building a dunking tank.
While working on a commercial, Ann's voice is dubbed by a singer that she finds fantastic. But her efforts to give this young woman a boost in her career may not go so well.
Ann gets hired to do a television skit where she gets a pie in the face and the bit becomes a big hit.
A stray dog that follows Ann home decides to bite her visiting father.
While shopping, Ann becomes sympathetic to an eight-year-old boy who tries to steal a candy bar.
The United States Air Force hires Ann to recruit women to the WAFS for potential space travel.
A lonely night at Ann's apartment is interrupted by a mouse.
After burning a hole in Felix's bed, Oscar despairs of raising the money for a new one. But a poker session with his old college friend, Monty Hall, leads to an idea.
When Oscar's mother fears for her son's social life, Felix finds him an-old-fashioned Greek girlfriend.
As a surprise for Oscar, Felix paints the apartment flaming peach, sells the old furniture at a rummage sale and refurnishes the apartment with futuristic pieces.
When Murray's wife ejects him from their home, Felix invites him to share his and Oscar's apartment.
Oscar is literally put out when Felix invites his former wife to share the apartment while her house is being painted.
Carol organizes a protest to save the neighborhood park.
Carol submits an article about her family to a magazine.
